programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Down Under
programs.desc: Phil is in magnificent Melbourne waiting to surprise a couple of Brits fresh off the plane and find them their dream home down under.

programs.title: Grand Designs UK
programs.desc: Kevin McCloud examines an ambitious upside-down, New Zealand-inspired hill house clinging to a steep slope. The couple bought the Malvern Hills plot in Worcestershire through the internet without seeing it first.

programs.title: Claire Hooper's House Of Games
programs.desc: Hanging out in Claire Hooper's House of Games this week, we've got performer Eddie Perfect, swimmer Emily Seebohm, and comedians Alex Lee and Dave Thornton testing their wits for the chance to win a bread bin. Or a trophy.

programs.title: Spicks and Specks
programs.sub_title: Lloyd Cole, Emily Browning, Sammy J & Dave O'neil
programs.desc: Joining Adam Hills are Lloyd Cole, Emily Browning, Sammy J, Dave O'Neil, and Raga Dolls Salon Orchestra.

programs.title: QI
programs.desc: Gyles Brandreth, Victoria Coren Mitchell and Jimmy Carr join regular panellist Alan Davies and host Sandi Toksvig to contemplate the theme of 'not nearly'. As usual, correctness and intelligence go out of the window.

programs.title: Would I Lie To You?
programs.sub_title: Rhod Gilbert, Jamie Laing, Tracy-ann Oberman & Claudia Winkleman
programs.desc: Host Rob Brydon is joined by team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack along with guests Rhod Gilbert, Jamie Laing, Tracy-Ann Oberman and Claudia Winkleman as they try to deceive their opponents with plausible lies.
